capabilities: Set a link on a selected canvas image via right-click menu or command
Open the configured link by double-clicking the image
Support web URLs, file:// paths, and obsidian:// vault URLs
Display the configured link underneath the image
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README covers manual installation only, with no community-plugin-store instructions.
problem: Obsidian Canvas images cannot carry links, so there is no way to open a related URL or file directly from an image on a canvas.
summary: Canvas plugin that lets users attach a link to any image node and open it by double-clicking the image.
